what: A board of 240 pale gray dot cells lights text (numbers like 1,000,000) out of dots. When 60% of the board is visible, after .15s and over 3s (inOutQuad), starting from the left with each cell slightly staggered, the dots spread a ring (1.5r→6r), swell to 2.6x and return, lighting up in left color → center → right color by cell position. Once fully lit, the background dots twinkle one every 10ms for 1.8 seconds in their cell’s color.

options.text: Text to bloom, default is the text inside canvas
options.at: How much must be visible to start, default .6
options.--fx-dot-a / -b / -c: Left, center and right dot colors (default is purple, magenta and apricot rotated from the accent color)

note: Glyph shape is drawn with the canvas font-family (default --kf-font-display, 600). When the panel shrinks the cell size shrinks too and it is drawn again
